published_guides.title: How to Store Crypto Seed Phrases & Sensitive IDs Offline With Plausible Deniability
published_guides.desc:
Most 'encrypted' mobile vaults fail the moment someone forces you to unlock your phone.

Why? Because a standard password box confirms the vault exists—and most apps sync encrypted blobs to a cloud database you don't control.

At BoldFrame AI Studio, we engineered the AURA Zero-K
